facts.fact: The Media Foundation for West Africa describes Mali's 2019 Cybercrime Law as in application, with a National Cybercrime Unit and Court enforcing it.

MFWA says the National Cybercrime Court sentenced editor Youssouf Sissoko in March 2026 to two years and a CFA 1 million fine for 'false information', and the Bamako Court of Appeal sentenced Ras Bath and Rose Vie Chère on 17 August 2026 on charges under information and communication technologies.

MFWA says authorities have systematically used the 2019 Cybercrime Law against journalists, naming cases from November 2024 to June 2026 (Joliba TV guest, Sissoko, Takiou, Keita, Bathily and Doumbia).
